investigation: Ramshaw-Phathanapirom pressure-tensor SC force form + higher-density-ratio pseudopotential (density-ratio lever)
verdict: NEGATIVE -- the pressure-tensor (divergence) form is leading-order equivalent to the standard SC force (no new degree of freedom) and is numerically UNSTABLE at the fine grid (a=80); the density-ratio lever is already ruled out by the existing G-sweep because for psi_exp G monotonically controls the coexistence density ratio.

variants.standard: default, historical SC D2Q9 stencil F=-G*psi*sum_i w_i c_i psi(x-c_i); bit-identical to before
variants.pressure_tensor: F = -(G/2) * sum_i w_i psi^2(x-c_i) c_i  (isotropic D2Q9 stencil evaluation of F=-(G_eff/2)*grad(psi^2)); leading-order identical to standard; Sigma_x F == 0 EXACTLY (Newton-3) because sum_i w_i c_i = 0; keeps the standard stencil -> no checkerboard decoupling
variants.pressure_tensor_cd: F = (G*cs2/2)*D(psi^2) with central differences D; exactly curl-free (central differences commute on a rectangular grid -> discrete curl == 0 identically) but UNSTABLE at a=80 (odd-even/checkerboard decoupling)

implemented.default_unchanged: force_scheme defaults to 'standard'; a=40/80 default reruns reproduce the historical errors

pressure_tensor_results.note: err_MM (%) at T=1 / T=2 / T=2.96; 1600 steps, g=2e-4
pressure_tensor_results.conclusion: At the only resolution at which it is stable (a=40) the pt form is WORSE than standard at all three checkpoints. At a=80 it is unstable unless G is lowered, and at G=4.5 it coincides with the STANDARD scheme at G~4.6 (35/19/1 vs 31/17/1) i.e. the pt form is just a ~0.1 reparametrisation of the effective coupling G -- it adds NO independent degree of freedom, exactly as the leading-order-analytic equivalence (F = -(G_eff/2)grad(psi^2) = -G_eff psi grad psi + O(h^2)) predicts. It therefore cannot break the (err(T=1), err(T=2.96)) structural obstacle.
pressure_tensor_results.instability_mechanism: The standard SC force carries an O(h^2) non-gradient (vortical) component that acts as extra interfacial dissipation; the divergence form removes it, so the psi^2 nonlinearity (quadratic in psi, vs linear for the standard psi*psi) can run away at fine resolution.

density_ratio_lever.finding: For psi_exp the library coupling G monotonically controls the discrete coexistence density ratio, so the existing G-sweep IS the density-ratio sweep -- lever (c) is already covered by data on record.

error_vs_ratio.note: from the on-record G-sweep (a=80): higher ratio (higher G) SLOWS the front at ALL times
error_vs_ratio.deduction: err(T=1) crosses zero at ratio~12.7; err(T=2.96) crosses zero at ratio~6.9 (G~4.65). Opposite-required ratios -> the structural obstacle is a DENSITY-RATIO (constitutive) obstacle, not a force-form one. A HIGHER density ratio (which is what Carnahan-Starling offers) makes T=2.96 MORE negative -> the wrong direction.

existing_psi_carnahan_starling_is_broken.sign_error: the shipped psi_carnahan_starling computes sqrt(2*(p_EOS - rho*cs2)/cs2); the library's attractive convention (G_lib>0, F=+G_lib*cs2*psi*grad psi, p = rho*cs2 - (G_lib*cs2/2)*psi^2) requires sqrt(2*(rho*cs2 - p_EOS)/(G_lib*cs2)) -- the SIGN is inverted and it clamps the vapour branch (p_EOS<rho*cs2) to psi=0
existing_psi_carnahan_starling_is_broken.no_spinodal: with the hard-coded a=0.5, b=4, RT=1/3 the CS EOS has d p/d rho > 0 EVERYWHERE (no van der Waals loop, no spinodal) -> the model CANNOT phase-separate; this explains the historical '--psi cs diverges at step 20'

carnahan_starling_investigation.stability: the corrected CS pseudopotential is still numerically stiff: both the spinodal-random init and a smooth liquid-slab init diverge within ~1000 steps (G_lib=1..3, tau=1.0). Not usable for the dam break within budget.
carnahan_starling_investigation.disposition: the density-ratio lever is in any case already ruled out (see density_ratio_lever): a higher ratio moves T=2.96 further negative. So a working CS would not break the obstacle either.

new_tooling: scripts/measure_coexistence.py -- SCMP coexistence-density measurement (validated: psi_exp G=5 -> ratio 12.58 vs the on-record 12.3)

final.best_stable_config_remains: velocity_shift / guo standard, ~+2.5/-9.5/-19.1 (a=80); the pressure-tensor form only reproduces the same family
final.structural_obstacle_confirmed: err(T=1) and err(T=2.96) demand OPPOSITE coexistence density ratios (12.7 vs 6.9). Neither the SC force discretisation (pressure tensor = leading-order-equivalent to standard) nor a higher-density-ratio pseudopotential can null both; only a genuinely new mechanism (e.g. wall/contact-line physics or a two-fluid gas with independent properties) could.
